cases.name: percent_commission_round_trip
cases.source: Pyne-defined percent-commission strategy fixture with a Pine-equivalent scaffold for external TradingView export comparison.
cases.script:
strategy("Pine Equivalent Percent Commission", overlay=True, initial_capital=1000, pyramiding=0, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=1)
strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=2, when=bar_index == 0, price=close)
strategy.close("Long", when=bar_index == 1, price=close)
plot(strategy.position_size, "Position")
plot(strategy.equity, "Equity")
plot(strategy.netprofit, "Net Profit")
plot(strategy.openprofit, "Open Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades, "Closed Trades")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(0), "Closed Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.commission(0), "Closed Commission")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.net_profit(0), "Closed Net Profit")
cases.pine_equivalent:
//@version=5
strategy("Pine Equivalent Percent Commission", overlay=true, initial_capital=1000, pyramiding=0, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=1, process_orders_on_close=true)
if bar_index == 0
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=2)
if bar_index == 1
    strategy.close("Long")
plot(strategy.position_size, "Position")
plot(strategy.equity, "Equity")
plot(strategy.netprofit, "Net Profit")
plot(strategy.openprofit, "Open Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades, "Closed Trades")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(0), "Closed Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.commission(0), "Closed Commission")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(0) - strategy.closedtrades.commission(0), "Closed Net Profit")
pine_equivalent_notes: Percent commission is 1% of traded notional.
Entry notional is 20.0, entry commission is 0.2; close notional is 24.0, close commission is 0.24.

notes: Populate values from TradingView's exported plot data when an external capture is available.

cases.name: cash_per_contract_partial_close_allocation
cases.source: Pyne-defined cash-per-contract partial-close strategy fixture with a Pine-equivalent scaffold for external TradingView export comparison.
cases.script:
strategy("Pine Equivalent Contract Partial", overlay=True, initial_capital=1000, pyramiding=0, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=0.25)
strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=4, when=bar_index == 0, price=close)
strategy.close("Long", when=bar_index == 1, qty_percent=50, price=close)
strategy.close_all(when=bar_index == 2, price=close)
plot(strategy.position_size, "Position")
plot(strategy.equity, "Equity")
plot(strategy.netprofit, "Net Profit")
plot(strategy.openprofit, "Open Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades, "Closed Trades")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(0), "First Closed Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.commission(0), "First Closed Commission")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.net_profit(0), "First Closed Net Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(1), "Last Closed Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.commission(1), "Last Closed Commission")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.net_profit(1), "Last Closed Net Profit")
cases.pine_equivalent:
//@version=5
strategy("Pine Equivalent Contract Partial", overlay=true, initial_capital=1000, pyramiding=0, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=0.25, process_orders_on_close=true)
if bar_index == 0
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=4)
if bar_index == 1
    strategy.close("Long", qty_percent=50)
if bar_index == 2
    strategy.close_all()
plot(strategy.position_size, "Position")
plot(strategy.equity, "Equity")
plot(strategy.netprofit, "Net Profit")
plot(strategy.openprofit, "Open Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades, "Closed Trades")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(0), "First Closed Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.commission(0), "First Closed Commission")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(0) - strategy.closedtrades.commission(0), "First Closed Net Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(1), "Last Closed Profit")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.commission(1), "Last Closed Commission")
plot(strategy.closedtrades.profit(1) - strategy.closedtrades.commission(1), "Last Closed Net Profit")
pine_equivalent_notes: Cash-per-contract commission is 0.25 per filled unit.
The partial close allocates half of the entry commission to the first closed trade, and close_all allocates the remaining entry commission to the second closed trade.

notes: Populate values from TradingView's exported plot data when an external capture is available.
